homePage.question: What exactly is an AI-powered digital agency?
homePage.answer: An AI-powered digital agency uses artificial intelligence as its operating infrastructure — not just a collection of tools. Avataworks uses agentic AI workflows to automate the full marketing pipeline at scale, while human Avata specialists review and approve every output before it reaches clients or their audiences. The result is AI efficiency with human accountability on every deliverable.

homePage.question: What does Avata-reviewed mean for my brand's content?
homePage.answer: Every Avataworks deliverable is reviewed, refined, and approved by a trained human Avata before it goes live. AI generates at speed and volume. Your Avata guarantees brand accuracy, creative quality, and cultural relevance for your ideal customer avatar. You never receive raw, unreviewed AI output.

homePage.question: How does Avataworks generate more leads for my business?
homePage.answer: We combine AI-powered paid advertising on Meta, TikTok, Google, and LinkedIn with automated lead capture systems, CRM integration, and 24/7 follow-up sequences. This creates an always-on lead generation machine that captures, qualifies, and nurtures prospects even when you're offline — reducing your cost per lead while increasing volume and quality.

homePage.question: How much does it cost to work with Avataworks?
homePage.answer: Fixed monthly plans: Brand Startup from ₦400K/month (1 brand, IG + Facebook, 30 AI-augmented content drafts), Growth Partner from ₦1.2M/month (4 platforms, Meta Ads, CRM automation), and Enterprise Avata from ₦3.7M/month (full AI stack, all 6 platforms, Paid Ads, Voice AI, website builds). Advertising spend is always separate and passed through at zero markup.

homePage.question: Do you offer customised solutions for each business?
homePage.answer: Absolutely. Every engagement starts with an Avata Audit Session, a deep-dive into your goals, market, and competitive landscape. Every strategy and deliverable is built from scratch for your brand, never recycled templates. The productized plans define the scope and price. The execution is always specific to you.

homePage.question: How does SEO work, and why is it essential for my business?
homePage.answer: Search Engine Optimization (SEO) enhances your brand's visibility on search engines like Google and social media search engines like Instagram, X, and more. By optimizing your channels' content, structure, bio, and technical aspects, you can rank higher in search results, leading to increased organic traffic and potential customers.

homePage.question: Who exactly will be working on my account?
homePage.answer: A dedicated Avata squad, your primary Avata contact supported by specialists in strategy, design, development, and paid media. You will always know who you are talking to and how your project is progressing. An Avata squad with a single senior point of contact, weekly strategy reviews, and a monthly performance report. Nothing moves without your awareness.

homePage.question: What makes Avataworks different from other digital agencies?
homePage.answer: Three things no other agency offers: a documented 5-step Avata Human-in-the-Loop pipeline where every AI output is reviewed before release; agentic AI workflows that execute marketing operations autonomously 24/7; and fixed monthly pricing with zero markup on advertising spend. We are built AI-first — not AI-added-on to traditional agency operations.

homePage.question: Will AI content make my brand look generic?
homePage.answer: No, because every piece of content is reviewed by a human Avata who understands the market nuance, your brand voice, and your ideal customer avatar before anything is published. The AI generates at scale; the Avata guarantees it sounds like your brand. Clients consistently report their content sounds more consistent and more on-brand than before Avataworks.

servicePage.question: Do you offer customized solutions for businesses?
servicePage.answer: Absolutely. We understand that each business is unique. Our team collaborates closely with clients to develop tailored strategies and solutions aligning with their goals and challenges.

servicePage.question: Can Avataworks handle both small and large-scale projects?
servicePage.answer: Yes, we are equipped to manage projects of all sizes. Whether you're a start-up looking to establish your brand or a large corporation aiming to enhance your digital presence, we have the expertise to deliver results.

servicePage.question: Do you work with businesses outside Africa?
servicePage.answer: Yes. Avataworks was built in Lagos for the African market, but our AI-native delivery model means we work effectively with brands across Africa and globally. If your business operates across borders or targets international markets, our Avata squad is equipped to build and execute for that scale.

servicePage.question: What is your client onboarding process
servicePage.answer: Once you sign, three things happen immediately. Your Avata squad conducts an Avata Audit Session, capturing your brand voice, business goals, competitive landscape, and target customer avatar. We then present a tailored strategy plan before a single piece of content or creative is produced. Execution follows with regular updates, performance monitoring, and optimisation built into the rhythm of every month. You approve before anything goes live.

servicePage.question: How quickly can you get started?
servicePage.answer: Most engagements kick off within 3 business days of your Avata Audit Session. First brand identity concepts typically arrive within 48 hours of brief sign-off. Website and campaign timelines are scoped in the strategy brief before execution begins, you always know what is coming and when before we move.

servicePage.answer: A dedicated Avata squad, your primary Avata contact supported by specialists in strategy, design, development, and paid media. You will always know who you are talking to and how your project is progressing. An Avata squad with a single senior point of contact, weekly strategy reviews, and a monthly performance report. Nothing moves without your awareness.

servicePage.question: Do you offer training or workshops for in-house teams?
servicePage.answer: Yes. We are brand builders, we offer training sessions and workshops covering content creation, digital marketing strategy, and AI-assisted execution, designed for in-house teams that want to build internal capability alongside their Avata engagement. Sessions are available for small teams and larger groups. Reach out to discuss formats, dates, and pricing.
